## Experience

- **Lead Data Scientist** at Best Egg (09/2024 – 10/2025) — Credit risk modeling, MLOps, and ML pipeline infrastructure for consumer fintech lending. Built XGBoost models with iterative tuning, end-to-end Metaflow MLOps pipelines, and an agentic RAG system with tool-use orchestration.
- **Senior Data Engineer** at Burns & McDonnell (04/2024 – 07/2024) — Databricks lakehouse ingestion/transformation with Airflow DAGs and dbt.
- **Graduate Learning Facilitator** at University of Texas at Austin (01/2024 – 04/2024) — TA for graduate-level ML course (~465 students).
- **Data Scientist** at Propense.ai (05/2023 – 08/2023) — Knowledge graph augmentation and B2B recommendation systems.
- **Quant Investments & Data Science Intern** at Nexus Equities (02/2023 – 05/2023) — PyTorch computer vision for commercial real estate.
- **Software Development Engineer – EC2 Core Platform** at Amazon Web Services (10/2018 – 01/2021) — EC2 host lifecycle services, Python/PySpark data lake on AWS, ML-based capacity forecasting.
- **Software Development Engineer – HDInsight** at Microsoft Azure (08/2016 – 10/2018) — Time series anomaly detection ML models deployed on Azure, Apache Hadoop reliability.
- **Design Studio Software Developer** at Hudl (09/2015 – 05/2016) — CNN-based basketball highlight detection, A/B testing for ML models.
